searchText: Yes, I agree with you. I also think that it should be `INVALID` . Do you have a hive test that we could run? cc:<@277500722655002624> makes sense to me to return invalid there Yes you can use branch https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/refactor-legacy-engine-api-tests and command: ``` ./hive --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <nethermind or go-ethereum or any client> --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-cancun/Invalid Blob" ``` Should run four similar test cases, but two of them are syncing variants. If you have time and want to check the rest of the tests you can run with `--sim.limit "engine-cancun/"`, and this will run around 180 tests, but there might be some test issues here and there also the logs have increased significantly because almost all tests send blob txs and these end up in the logs, I still need to work on reducing these sizes Thanks!

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Yes you can use branch https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/refactor-legacy-engine-api-tests and command:
```
./hive --client-file ./configs/cancun.yaml --client <nethermind or go-ethereum or any client> --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-cancun/Invalid Blob"
```

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
Should run four similar test cases, but two of them are syncing variants.

If you have time and want to check the rest of the tests you can run with `--sim.limit "engine-cancun/"`, and this will run around 180 tests, but there might be some test issues here and there
